title: UI: PropertiesPanel W/H inputs for ShapeDisplayObject and locked-aspect resize for InstanceView
description:
Two PropertiesPanel improvements in packages/authoring-ui/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx:

1. ShapeView missing W/H direct pixel inputs: ShapeView (~line 393) shows X, Y, Rot, SX%, SY% but no direct W/H pixel fields. Add W and H NumInput fields that:
   - Read: compute from transformedShapeBounds(shape) * scaleX/scaleY (the bounds helper is in @flash/core)
   - Write: convert pixel W/H back to scaleX/scaleY = newW / naturalWidth, dispatch updateDisplayObject
   - Look at how InstanceView handles naturalWidth/naturalHeight as a reference

2. InstanceView locked-aspect resize: InstanceView (~line 738) shows naturalWidth/naturalHeight as read-only labels. Add editable W/H NumInput fields (similar to ShapeView fix above) plus an aspect-lock toggle (a lock icon button):
   - When aspect locked: changing W auto-updates H = newW * (naturalHeight/naturalWidth) and vice versa
   - Store lock state in local React state
   - Dispatch scaleX/scaleY updates via updateDisplayObject

Use the existing NumInput component and the same pattern as other property inputs in the panel. No new dependencies needed.
Run tests: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run (must stay at 612)
